correctness.rationale: Assuming the prior Kotwal--Menon closure parametrization \(W_k=V_kPV_{k-1}^*\) with \(V_0=I\) and \(V_N=Q\), the product telescopes to \(W_N\cdots W_1=QP^N\). Thus two labels through the same point differ by a unitary fixing \(E=\operatorname{im}P\) pointwise, and every such terminal-unitary change leaves the tuple unchanged, giving a \(U(d-r)\) label fiber. Pairwise and multiple intersections are exactly controlled by common equalizer subspaces. The fixed-rank dimension is \(2r(f-r)+r^2+(N-1)(d^2-(d-r)^2)=2r(f+(N-1)d)-Nr^2\). The \(N=2\) specialization agrees with the direct linear description. No internal mathematical error was found.
